decision.label: INFERRED
decision.reason: All plausible level-changing recovered-artifact families are closed or bounded. Remaining gates are mutable target installation, authorization, services, connectivity, media, and historical state that static artifacts cannot resolve.
decision.recommended_next_action: Run A1, then B1 only if Yelp is visible; record the first stable state and stop.
decision.statement: Static research is exhausted; one or more specific target observations are now the correct next step.

excluded_first_pass_actions: No Yelp search, voice request, dial, or route during B1.
No TCP 11111 or other listener probe, port forwarding, local helper, or diagnostic command.
No credential, TLS interception, DNS override, backend replay, or private/historical endpoint contact.
No registration, purchase, ASSIST call, VSB/DRM trigger, application install/update/reset, timer export, or upload.
No policy, trust, signature, firmware, vehicle configuration, or recovered artifact change.
notes_hash_encoding: Canonical sorted ASCII JSON with LF

observations.action: Record the existing software/part-number screen, then photograph every ordinary Apps page, category, favorites, and running view without launching an app.
observations.falsifies: A claimed currently visible tile if absent from every recorded ordinary view; it does not falsify installation or daemon execution.
observations.label: TARGET OBSERVATION REQUIRED
observations.name: Passive stock inventory
observations.proves: What the ordinary HMI exposes at that time and whether Yelp/Store/Register/ASSIST/Performance entries are visible.
observations.stop_condition: Stop after all existing Apps views and version screen are recorded; do not open a tile.
visible_states: No tile for a headless daemon is expected

observations.action: If an owner already has a non-mutating official package/version export, service log, or IXC inventory, preserve it and compare exact app versions/bind names; issue no new diagnostic command.
observations.falsifies: Only the matching recorded identity/state; absence does not prove the component never ran.
observations.label: TARGET OBSERVATION REQUIRED
observations.name: Existing package/service evidence only
observations.proves: Artifact identity or setup at the recorded time, subject to provenance.
observations.stop_condition: Stop if obtaining evidence would require a command, policy change, listener probe, or new logging.
visible_states: Existing VSB/DRM init or bind record

observations.action: After A1, if Yelp is visible, tap it once and record the first screen, exact error text, splash, time to transition, whether home/search appears, and whether it stays visible. Enter no search and press no phone/navigation action.
observations.falsifies: Only prerequisites earlier than the observed boundary; a failure does not falsify later static code paths or identify its cause without an exact error.
observations.label: TARGET OBSERVATION REQUIRED
observations.name: One normal Yelp launch
observations.proves: The deepest observed boundary among catalog visibility, authorization/AMS lifecycle, local resources/container, and pre-backend UI.
observations.stop_condition: Stop immediately at the first stable home screen, exact error, or return to Apps; no search, voice, call, route, packet injection, or socket probe.

observations.action: Only if Yelp is absent and the owner chooses the second candidate, tap the visible Performance Pages tile once and record name/variant cues, first screen, exact error, and stable landing UI. Do not start a timer, save, export, or upload.
observations.falsifies: Only the corresponding observed activation hypothesis; it does not test media or VSB.
observations.label: TARGET OBSERVATION REQUIRED
observations.name: One normal Performance Pages launch
observations.proves: Visible variant and progress through vehicle predicate/AMS/local UI gates.
observations.stop_condition: Stop at first stable landing/error/return; do not enter timer or save/upload flows.

observations.action: Only after successful B1 and separate owner approval for network transmission, select one ordinary fixed category once; record loading, exact error, results, and details availability without choosing phone/navigation.
observations.falsifies: A result list falsifies claims that the current stock search path is wholly unavailable; a failure does not uniquely identify DNS, TLS, credential, account, or schema cause.
observations.label: TARGET OBSERVATION REQUIRED
observations.name: One stock Yelp category search
observations.proves: Progress through request construction, network/TLS/backend/schema, and stock result rendering to the deepest observed boundary.
observations.stop_condition: Stop at first results/details screen or exact error; do not dial, route, repeat, alter DNS/TLS, or inspect credentials.

observations.action: Only after C1 and separate approval, invoke Yelp's ordinary voice action once, speak a harmless generic term, and record recognition/cancel/error and whether the same results UI appears.
observations.falsifies: A successful result falsifies a claim that voice is disconnected from search; failure does not falsify the static listener/callback graph.
observations.label: TARGET OBSERVATION REQUIRED
observations.name: One stock voice search
observations.proves: Live VR discovery/session/callback and convergence into the stock request path to the deepest observed boundary.
observations.stop_condition: Stop after one recognition/result/error; do not repeat or use sensitive speech.

observations.action: With explicit owner approval for the selected side effect, choose exactly one result and either initiate the phone action or request navigation, never both in the same observation.
dependencies: Paired phone for dial or GPS/OpenNav/HMI for route
observations.falsifies: Only the selected live service hypothesis; it does not alter the proved static sender/receiver chain.
observations.label: TARGET OBSERVATION REQUIRED
observations.name: Typed Yelp phone or navigation handoff
observations.proves: Runtime availability of the selected typed receiver path to the deepest visible boundary.
observations.stop_condition: Stop/cancel at the first confirmation, call-state, route-state, or exact error; follow local law and owner safety requirements.

observations.action: With explicit approval and empty owner-controlled media, create one ordinary timer record and select one stock USB or SD save option; inspect the resulting timersResult file off-unit after supported removal.
observations.falsifies: A complete file falsifies a claim that the direct writer is unusable on that setup; UI success alone does not prove complete bytes.
observations.label: TARGET OBSERVATION REQUIRED
observations.name: One Performance Pages media export
observations.proves: Live variant, timer UI, mount/grant/write path, and off-unit durability to the observed boundary.
observations.stop_condition: Stop after one file inspection; do not craft names/content, reinsert for consumption, or upload.

observations.action: Do not use as closure probes. Registration, Store purchase/account confirmation, ASSIST calls, Performance upload, DRMSync/VSB triggers, app install/update/reset, and diagnostic/test commands require a separate objective and explicit authorization.
dependencies: Separate safety plan and owner authorization
observations.label: TARGET OBSERVATION REQUIRED
observations.name: State-changing service workflows
observations.proves: Nothing when skipped; their static paths are already classified.
observations.stop_condition: Stop before initiating any listed workflow.
